triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

First touch (R1199, 16:5xZ): **p0 · domain:devx** confirmed → `pm:queue`. Theme: main red (p0 stays for main red).

**Root cause, read from the logs:** the job `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` fails 1 of 2564 self-test cases. The failing case is "no mkdtempSync site in this tree takes a base the scan cannot read".
- It reports UNRESOLVED at `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/arms.ts:83`, with the message "base is not bound in this file".
- The cause is `prepareArmWorkdir(…, base: string = tmpdir())`, which hands a parameter-default base to `mkdtempSync`.
- The file arrived in PR #34841 (#34764, skill-evals runner), merged at 16:00Z.
- It is red on main push at `e05445e4` (16:09) and `13e0305c` (16:15), and on the 4-hourly run.

**Scope:** merge groups stay green, because the lane runs on main only. The queue is not stalled and nothing is ejected, so no jump applies.

**Fix route:** repo:objectstack#3, the seat that landed #34841, was knocked with the cause. Either make the base readable in that file, or teach the scan parameter defaults with a pin. Either way it lands with a green `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`.

Re: p0 #34934 · 2026-11-17T17:49Z

The fix is PR #34949 (head `8f7facaa`, area o3-F), now with L1-c. It is queued on green plus ACCEPT.

One thing to know when reading `main`: the failing case sits in dispatch-gates' SLOW tier. That tier runs only on push to `main`, on the schedule, or on `workflow_dispatch`. The PR and merge-group checks are green either way, so `main` turns green only on the first push-to-main run after #34949 merges. It is also why #34841 went in green. Local proof: `check-dispatch-gates.mjs --slow` at `8f7facaa` passes the mkdtemp case, which was UNRESOLVED at `189358f2`.
